additional_info.subject: Reported from RC
additional_info.body: Yesterday we were due to commission the Si Charge D Liquid cooled at Milence’s Test Facility in Arnhem – Netherlands. Unfortunately the Heliox Engineer (trained on the SiD) was unable to fully commission the charger, and the charger has now entered Error Mode. My colleague spoke with Catalina who was supporting with some interoperability configurations who with support from the Product Owner tried to resolve it, but very rightly decided against getting the Customer to alter anything with the HW. Thus we need a Level 3 Engineer to attend Milence and resolve this issue with a matter of Urgency. Milence has huge potential for us at Siemens

additional_info.subject: WO1869 Sudeep Sewkaransing will be on site on 04.02.25
0401563 - ID0401563-DC/Si-D/NL-[NULL] Request for Commissioning Support from L3 CRM:00314000140
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon colleagues,
I am reaching out regarding ticket
ID0401563
(WO1869), for commissioning support of Sicharge D
MP / S6 170003770.
Today, Sudeep went onsite, we powered on the charger and we found that the issue was on router XF3, as the charger was offline from SCB. By removing and inserting again the SIM card inside the router, the issue was solved and the charger went online on SCB.
Once the door was closed, I checked that the charger was configuring correctly, and we tested both outlets with an EV Charger Tester onsite. Both outlets charged correctly.
We completed the commissioning by connecting the OCPP Backend from the customer via wired connection.
The commissioning of the charger is complete, and there are no remaining open issues.
Thank you again for the support, I will proceed to close the ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
Smart Infrastructure
eMobility Service Delivery
Expert Services
SI E CS SD ES
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
Important notice: This e-mail and any attachment thereof contain corporate proprietary information. If you have received it by mistake, please notify us immediately by reply e-mail and delete this e-mail and its attachments from your system.
Thank you.
